# Thomas Boué — portfolio

> Personal portfolio of Thomas Boué, a software engineering student at Epitech specialised in backend development, cloud infrastructure and distributed systems. Bilingual site (English / French). Currently looking for two internships: part-time (Mon/Wed) September–February, then full-time March–August.

Main stack: Go, TypeScript, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Docker. The site itself is a React + NestJS + PostgreSQL project, deployed with Docker and GitHub Actions.

## Pages

- [Home](https://thomasboue.com/): about, experience, skills, projects, playground and contact form, on a single page.
- [Legal notice](https://thomasboue.com/mentions-legales): publisher and host information.
- [Privacy policy](https://thomasboue.com/confidentialite): personal data processing and rights.
